items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: I was studying Lester Young and it just happened.

ctx.x: That’s a big difference. Charlie Parker — there’s a famous interview between Paul Desmond and Charlie Parker where he says, “How did you go about inventing this new music?” He said, “I wasn’t trying to invent any new music,” he said, “I was studying Lester Young and it just happened.” And so when the guy said whatever you read before about me having my own way, that’s why. I wasn’t trying to do anything. So what came out was I was just learning to play jazz properly, correctly. If you’re doing that and you’re…
Wow. If you had a niece or nephew that was headed towards a career in jazz, would you have any real-life advice that you might tell them?
